title: The Trinity — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Most Christians profess one God in three persons, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. The doctrine was defined at the fourth-century councils of Nicaea and Constantinople. This overview edition presents The Trinity within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.

spec.overview: Most Christians profess one God in three persons, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. The doctrine was defined at the fourth-century councils of Nicaea and Constantinople.
core_beliefs: One divine essence in three persons
Christ fully divine and fully human
spec.adherents: Affirmed by Catholic, Orthodox, and most Protestant churches.

example.fact: The Nicene Creed remains the shared doctrinal standard across major branches.

spec.study_note: Core facts verified from public sources; adherent figures are estimates from the Pew Research Center.
